mendeleyauth: Special page title for Mendeley OAuth token management
mendeleyauth-config-missing: Error when OAuth config is missing. $1 is a comma-separated list of missing variable names (e.g. $wgMendeleyConsumerKey, $wgMendeleyConsumerSecret).
mendeleyauth-state-mismatch: Error when OAuth state does not match
mendeleyauth-updated: Last updated text. $1 is the date.
mendeleyauth-redirect-instruction: Instruction for Mendeley app redirect URI
mendeleyauth-register-app: Link to Mendeley Developer Portal for app registration. Use wikitext: [https://dev.mendeley.com/myapps.html Mendeley Developer Portal]
mendeleyimport-group-label: Label for Mendeley group ID input
mendeleyimport-scheduled: Message when jobs scheduled. $1 is the page count.
mendeleyimport-success: Message when pages created/updated. $1 is the page count.
mendeleyimport-invalid: Error when import returns no pages
mendeleyimport-api-error: Error when Mendeley API returns an error. $1 is the API error message (e.g. Unknown ID).
